breakdown.description: Stokes (creeping-flow) drag is applied at a Reynolds number that is not in the creeping-flow regime.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retains the Stokes drag formula (Fd = 3 pi mu D V) and does not correct it despite noting that Re is large. The ground truth requires recognizing that Stokes drag is invalid when Re is not << 1 and switching to an appropriate drag-coefficient correlation (Cd(Re)) with Fd = (1/2) rho V^2 Cd A. The agent repeated the original error.
